description: List your GrowSurf program's webhooks (secrets are never returned). Targets `campaignId` if you pass it, otherwise GROWSURF_CAMPAIGN_ID.

campaignId.description: Target program (campaign) id for this call. Defaults to GROWSURF_CAMPAIGN_ID when omitted. Pass the `id` returned by growsurf_create_campaign to configure or operate a program you just created, without restarting the server.

name: growsurf_list_campaign_webhooks

items.description: A program webhook's configuration plus read-only delivery-health fields.

autoDisabledDueToFailures.description: Read-only. Whether the webhook was auto-disabled after repeated delivery failures.

events.description: Webhook events this endpoint is subscribed to.

id.description: The webhook id (`primary` for the program's primary webhook).

isEnabled.description: Whether deliveries to this webhook are enabled.

lastFailureAt.description: Read-only. When the last delivery failure occurred, as a Unix timestamp in milliseconds.

payloadUrl.description: The URL that receives webhook deliveries.

title: List Webhooks
